text:
Gold Price in 2021
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2021, the LBMA gold price fell 3.1% between 2021-01-29 ($1,864) and 2021-12-30 ($1,806). The highest sampled price was $1,900 in May and the lowest was $1,691 in March. The mean of these observations was $1,791. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
